items.title: Fine-Grained RAG Permissions with Qdrant and SpiceDB
items.summary: Fine-Grained RAG Permissions with Qdrant and SpiceDBTime: 45 min Level: Intermediate Output: GitHub A standard RAG pipeline answers questions using information retrieved from your documents. Qdrant stores their embeddings and associated metadata and finds relevant documents to provide as context to the language model. But without an authorization step, any user can get an answer from any document in the collection, including documents they aren’t allowed to read. The OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications lists this kind of leak as Sensitive Information Disclosure.
